title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Fresh Eluta results validated from accessible full postings. Scores measure technical and domain fit only.
could_not_validate: Senior Infrastructure Engineer (ML Inference) — Artificial.Agency: Eluta says remote may be possible only for exceptional candidates; no accessible full posting confirmed eligibility or requirements.
Lead Infrastructure Engineer — Electronic Arts: fresh remote-indexed result, but the accessible sources did not expose enough regional and role detail to score safely.

notes_sections.heading: Excluded or stale
items: PLATO DevOps Engineer (Azure ARO) and PLATO Infrastructure Engineer: excluded under the profile's explicit PLATO eligibility hard gate; both also require current Secret clearance.
Leap Tools DevOps Engineer: Eluta labels it recent, but authoritative sources date the posting roughly two to three months earlier; preserved as Likely expired — checked September 16.
Director, Cloud Engineering — Magnet Forensics: people-management role rather than an individual-contributor platform position.
Cloud Network Engineer — Clir: junior scope and CAD $40,000–$45,000 salary.
Zscaler SRE — DXC: Ottawa role is exclusively on-site.
Reliability Engineer — Galderma: manufacturing reliability, unrelated to software SRE.

notes_sections.heading: Run notes
items: Completed 10 Canada-remote title searches and 15 reachable-city searches across Ottawa, Kingston, Brockville, Cornwall, and Montréal.
Orion Digital and Newfold Digital were recovered through current full descriptions after Eluta supplied discovery results.
No fresh eligible hybrid role was found. Kingston, Brockville, and Cornwall had no fresh target-family result.
Known pipeline matches: Case IQ is applied; BMO's Senior Cloud Engineer is rejected.
All browser activity was read-only. No Apply, Email, Notify Me, account, or form controls were used.

notes_sections.heading: September 18 refresh delta
items: Senior DevOps Developer — Autodesk and Principal SRE / SRE Team Lead — Cerence appeared as fresh remote-indexed results, but stable full descriptions and regional requirements were not exposed during this run, so neither was scored.
Lead Site Reliability Engineer — Movable Ink is fresh but matches the existing rejected pipeline role.
Case IQ and Orion Digital/Mogo remain visible at two days old; both are already represented in the pipeline and retained in the validated table.
The reachable-city pass encountered an Eluta UI timeout after confirming the city autocomplete path; no unvalidated snippet was promoted to the scored table.
